description: Nested full splats on a list give a list of the inner splats' tuples
notes: The spec's grammar doesn't nest a second splat inside a full splat, which would make this ["x", "y"], and it doesn't give the result type of a splat over a list, while the for expressions it compares splats to produce tuples. hashicorp/hcl nests the second splat, which wraps each string in a one-element tuple, and collects the results for a list source in a list (parseExpressionTraversals in hclsyntax/parser.go, SplatExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
